of this practice on sleep architecture and in delaying sleep pressure at night.
In short, just nap—don’t add coffee.
JET LAG STRATEGIES
Sleep expert Ian Dunican, PhD, knows a thing or two about jet lag. He
worked with Western Force, an Australian professional rugby union team
from Perth, which had the distinction of flying the most miles of any
professional sports team in the world. If anybody knows about jet lag
strategies, it’s Dr. Dunican. Targeted circadian strategies such as
specifically time light exposure, meal-timing, altering training schedules,
and melatonin supplementation can help support phase shifts during
travel.57 The following list includes Dr. Dunican’s tips for preflight, in-
flight, and postflight strategies to fight off jet lag so you can perform on the
field or in the boardroom (see table 1.1).
